paseo.commit_message:
fix(cli): confirm daemon restart when provider probes are slow (#6009)

paseo daemon restart gave each daemon status read one second. Status probes
every provider binary, which takes longer than that on machines with several
providers installed, so restart kept retrying until its deadline and reported
RESTART_NOT_CONFIRMED after the worker had already been replaced.

The status read now gets the remaining restart deadline. Connecting to the
replacement keeps its one-second bound, so polling a worker that is not up
yet stays responsive.

Co-authored-by: paseo-bot[bot] <266920839+paseo-bot[bot]@users.noreply.github.com>

ruflo.release_body:
Security patch for `@claude-flow/cli`, `claude-flow` and `ruflo` (`latest`, `alpha`, `v3alpha` → 3.51.1). Upgrading is recommended.

**PreToolUse `pre-bash` denials now block (#3623).** When the hook handler recognised a denied command, it exited with status 1. Claude Code treats that as a non-blocking hook error, so the command could still run. Denials now exit 2, the status Claude Code's PreToolUse uses to block. The fix covers both shipped `hook-handler.cjs` copies and the handler `ruflo init` generates. Existing projects pick it up with `npx ruflo@latest init upgrade` (or a helper refresh).

**MCP tools send credentials only to configured services (#3624).** `x_federation_*` and `seraphina_guidance` read env-only credentials (`RUFLO_X_ADMIN_TOKEN`, `SERAPHINA_METALLM_KEY`). Their destinations are now pinned to the server-configured HTTPS base (`RUFLO_X_GATEWAY_URL`, `SERAPHINA_METALLM_URL`). A URL tool argument is only an assertion that must match that base; an absent, null or empty argument means no assertion. Every credential-bearing request rejects redirects. Operator configuration may name a loopback HTTP service for local or self-hosted gateways.

Verified: signed helper manifest at 3.51.1, witness manifests 117/117 on linux, macOS and Windows. A fresh `npx ruflo@3.51.1 init` writes the exit-2 handler.

GenericAgent Desktop 桌面版 / Desktop

三个平台产物来自同一提交，并在公开发布前统一验证。All three platform artifacts come from one commit and are validated before publication.

## 安装方法 / Installation
- Windows x64：下载 `GenericAgent-Desktop-Windows-Portable.zip`，解压后双击 `GenericAgent.exe`。卸载时运行 `uninstall.bat`，再删除解压目录。
  Windows x64: extract `GenericAgent-Desktop-Windows-Portable.zip`, then launch `GenericAgent.exe`. Run `uninstall.bat` before deleting the extracted directory.
- Linux x86_64：下载并解压 `GenericAgent-Desktop-Linux-Portable.tar.gz`，执行 `chmod +x GenericAgent.AppImage` 后运行它。卸载时运行 `uninstall.sh`，再删除解压目录。
  Linux x86_64: extract `GenericAgent-Desktop-Linux-Portable.tar.gz`, run `chmod +x GenericAgent.AppImage`, then launch it. Run `uninstall.sh` before deleting the extracted directory.
- macOS Apple silicon (arm64)：打开 `GenericAgent-Desktop-macOS-aarch64.dmg`，把 `GenericAgent.app` 拖入 Applications。
  macOS Apple silicon (arm64): open `GenericAgent-Desktop-macOS-aarch64.dmg` and drag `GenericAgent.app` to Applications.

## 签名状态 / Signing status
Windows 便携版尚未使用代码签名证书，SmartScreen 可能显示警告；运行前请核对 `SHA256SUMS-windows.txt`。
The Windows portable build is not code-signed, so SmartScreen may warn; verify `SHA256SUMS-windows.txt` before running it.

macOS 应用仅使用 ad-hoc 签名，未使用 Apple Developer ID，也未 notarize。首次打开可能需要右键选择“打开”或在“隐私与安全性”中允许。
The macOS app is ad-hoc signed only. It is neither Developer ID signed nor notarized; first launch may require Open from the context menu or approval in Privacy & Security.

SHA-256 清单与各产物一同发布。SHA-256 manifests are included with the artifacts.

claude_codex_bridge.release_body:
# v8.7.5

Released: 2026-09-30

## English

### OMP/Pi control-input reliability

- Opening `/model` or another control-only native selector no longer terminates an active OMP or Pi ask as superseded. The shared extension still binds recognized CCB dispatches immediately, but unmatched input alone is no longer treated as a replacement provider turn.
- A genuinely different prompt supersedes the active request only when it reaches the provider's `before_agent_start` lifecycle boundary. Explicit native `session_switch` events and later recognized CCB dispatches retain their existing replacement behavior and diagnostics.
- The fix is lifecycle-based rather than a `/model` command whitelist, so future control-only selectors do not need command-name exceptions.

### Verification and upgrade

- 302 focused Pi/OMP, runtime-launch, FIFO, and dispatcher regressions passed; two existing opt-in smoke tests were skipped. The generated Pi extension was executed with Bun to verify control input, real replacement turns, and native session switches, and the generated OMP extension was checked against the same boundary.
- In a disposable v8.7.5 source project, real OMP 18.3.5 switched from `paratera2/grok-4.6` to `bingxing/AWS-GPT-5.6-Sol` while job `job_727bce7356c0` was running a tool. The same attempt remained running, then completed once with exact reply `CCB_RELEASE_875_MODEL_SWITCH_OK`; no `request_superseded` event was emitted.
- Update CCB, then restart affected OMP/Pi panes or reopen the project when current work can safely be interrupted. Existing panes keep their already-loaded extension until restart. No project, conversation, or configuration migration is required.
- Android metadata and release assets remain synchronized with the coordinated release pipeline. This release adds no mobile UI behavior.

### Known limitations

- Pi uses the same repaired generated extension and passed Bun lifecycle replay plus pane-adapter regressions, but an authenticated real Pi TUI `/model` switch was not run separately for this release.
- The fix prevents false supersession; it does not make the entire native model-picker interaction atomic or recover unsaved drafts and in-flight provider operations after a process crash.

## 中文

### OMP/Pi 控制输入稳定性

- 打开 `/model` 或其他仅用于原生界面控制的选择器时，不再把正在执行的 OMP/Pi ask 误判为已被替换。共享扩展仍会立即绑定合法的 CCB 投递，但不会仅凭一条未匹配的输入事件终止当前任务。
- 只有不同的新提示真正到达 provider 的 `before_agent_start` 生命周期边界时，才会 supersede 当前请求。明确的原生 `session_switch` 事件和后续合法 CCB 投递仍保留原有替换语义及诊断信息。
- 修复依据生命周期边界，而不是维护 `/model` 命令白名单，因此未来新增的纯控制选择器无需逐个添加命令名称例外。

### 验证与升级

- 302 项 Pi/OMP、运行时启动、FIFO 和 dispatcher 聚焦回归通过；2 项原有的显式启用 smoke 测试跳过。测试使用 Bun 执行生成的 Pi 扩展，覆盖控制输入、真实替换回合和原生会话切换，并确认生成的 OMP 扩展采用相同边界。
- 在一次性 v8.7.5 源码项目中，真实 OMP 18.3.5 在任务 `job_727bce7356c0` 执行工具期间，从 `paratera2/grok-4.6` 切换到 `bingxing/AWS-GPT-5.6-Sol`。同一 attempt 在切换后保持 running，随后仅完成一次并精确返回 `CCB_RELEASE_875_MODEL_SWITCH_OK`，没有产生 `request_superseded` 事件。
- 更新 CCB 后，请在当前工作可以安全中断时重启受影响的 OMP/Pi pane，或重新打开项目。已有 pane 会继续使用启动时加载的旧扩展，直至重启。无需迁移项目、对话或配置。
- Android 元数据及发布产物继续使用现有统一发布流程；本版本没有新增手机端界面功能。

### 已知限制

- Pi 使用同一份已修复的生成扩展，并通过 Bun 生命周期回放及 pane adapter 回归，但本版本没有单独执行真实、已登录的 Pi TUI `/model` 切换。
- 本修复解决错误 supersede，不保证整个原生模型选择过程具备事务原子性，也不恢复进程崩溃前未提交的草稿或正在执行的 provider 操作。

> ## Documentation Index
> Fetch the complete documentation index at: https://docs.trytrellis.app/llms.txt
> Use this file to discover all available pages before exploring further.

# v0.6.17

> 2026-09-12

Devin CLI 会话记忆、按需读取 SQLite 页，以及任务/会话绑定修复。

## 功能增强

### Devin CLI 会话适配器

`trellis mem` 通过现有的零依赖解析器读取 Cognition Devin CLI 会话，数据在 `~/.local/share/devin/cli/sessions.db`（WAL SQLite）。这不是 `trellis init --devin`（Desktop/Cascade），也不是 Factory Droid。（#614）

* `list` / `search` / `extract` / `context` / `projects` 支持 `--platform devin`
* OpenCode、ZCode 与 Devin 共用 `packages/core/src/mem/internal/sqlite-adapter.ts` 和 `packages/core/src/mem/platforms.ts`
* Devin 会话树要求 `main_chain_id`；缺少 tip 时返回 `devin-main-chain-missing`（不再回退到 `max(node_id)`）
* 解析前去掉 `CREATE TABLE` 的 `--` 行注释，这样 live `sessions.db` 里的 `parent_node_id` 和 `chat_message` 能被识别

## 问题修复

### SQLite 主文件页懒读

`packages/core/src/mem/internal/sqlite-readonly.ts` 里的零依赖 SQLite 读取器按需加载主文件页，不再把整个数据库读进内存。（#596）

### Pi 无头子代理提示

Pi `trellis_subagent` 把 ask-policy 提示转发到父会话。serving heartbeat 设置 `PI_SUBAGENT_PARENT_SESSION`（不用过期的 `PI_SESSION_ID`），设置 `PI_SUBAGENT_CHILD=1`，并丢掉继承来的 `PI_SESSION_ID`，让子进程自己签发会话 id。（#611）

### 活动任务会话回退

当前会话 id 缺失时，不再回退到项目里仅有的那条会话去解析活动任务。该回退改为显式 opt-in，避免一个会话绑到另一个会话的任务。（#608）

### archive 子任务 unlink 回滚

如果 `task.py archive` 在已经 unlink 部分子任务之后失败，会按清除前的快照把每个子任务的 `parent` 写回去。`children` 里的重复条目只快照一次，避免第二次访问把 `parent: null` 写回去。（#613）

## 升级

```bash theme={null}
npm install -g @mindfoldhq/trellis@latest
trellis update
```

无需 `--migrate`。
